verdict.for_whom: This is for players who have a dedicated group of friends to play with and don't mind dealing with third-party launcher hurdles, but not for those sensitive to competitive cheating or battle-pass locked characters.

distortion_flags.sentence: Player sentiment starts low due to early technical issues, peaks during early play, and then declines significantly for veterans.
Player reviews over the past year have become noticeably more negative compared to the game's lifetime average.

cohorts.label: <2h refund window
cohorts.summary: Initial access is blocked by severe launcher errors, account creation failures, and immediate crashes during startup, tutorials, or active matches.

cohorts.label: 20-100h
cohorts.summary: Technical issues shift to specific graphics card crashes, while gameplay frustrations emerge regarding teammates who fail to utilize drones or setup defensive walls properly.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that recent updates cause performance issues and crashing specifically with AMD graphics cards.

citations.review_text: Recent update does not play well at all with AMD graphics. Constant crashing after recent update and screen flashes.

my dog was getting taken by aliens but I didn't want to get a penalty for a ranked match so I had to eat him. Then my teamate shot me 1 million times so I can not play the round because I forgot to shoot 0.127 degrees to the left and I got blown up because my pc does not like this game

claims.claim: Reviewers note that teammates in matches fail to use drones effectively or make poor plays such as reinforcing walls incorrectly.

citations.review_text: teammates don't drone and have the iq of a dead bird and will hate on YOU for missing a shot good game for punching monitors.

Jynxzi makes it look like Siege is playable.

Then you queue ranked and remember you’re just here to get pre-fired through a wall by a level 82 Smurf called “xXxASHMAINxXx” while your teammate is reinforcing a rotate in the middle of site.

Everyone in this game thinks they’re Beaulo, plays like they’re in Champs, and dies like they’ve never seen a staircase before. Gold players call you “braindead,” Emerald players say “team diff,” and the actual Champion on the enemy team is crouch-spamming in a pixel angle no human should ever find.

Half the deaths don’t even feel real. You drone, you clear, you clear again, and somehow there’s still a guy sitting in the one corner nobody ever checks. And your teammate instantly goes “why no drone?”

Chat is always the same too. “XIM,” “cheater,” “peekers advantage,” “hitreg trash,” like it’s never just someone outplaying you.

And every time you think it can’t get worse, Ubisoft drops a patch that somehow makes sound more confusing than it already was.

Still queue again though. No idea why.

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term players express frustration with cheaters, locked content behind battle passes, and security breaches that shut down the marketplace.

claims.claim: Reviewers state that the game is heavily impacted by cheaters, hackers, and recoil scripters, while the anti-cheat system is ineffective.
